create_context_embedding_net: create a ContextEmbeddingNet module to embed 32x32x32 voxel context grids into spatial embeddings
create_segment_embedding_net: create a SegmentEmbeddingNet module to embed 8x8x8 voxel segments into spatial embeddings
create_segment_direction_embedding_net: create a SegmentDirectionEmbeddingNet module to embed segment direction and viewer position into embeddings
create_context_segment_scoring: create a ContextSegmentScoringModule to compute dot product scores between context and segment embeddings
create_context_segment_modules: create all context segment modules including embedding nets, scoring, loss, and optimizer in one call
